blockers.quote: The shocks were fake, and the man in the next room was an actor. They didn't know. When they hesitated, the experimenter said: please continue. (c15, c16)
blockers.why: Claim c16 is marked contested because archival research (Perry 2013, Gibson 2013) found the experimenter frequently went off-script and improvised coercive prods. Contested rows must be spoken with a caveat rather than stating flatly as fact that the experimenter simply said 'please continue'.
blockers.fix: The shocks were fake, and the man in the next room was an actor. They didn't know. When they hesitated, the experimenter was scripted to say: please continue. (c15, c16)
